name: camphor (natural) + lidocaine
uses: USES For the temporary relief of muscle pain and joint pain associated with: -Backache -Cramps -Soreness -Strains -Discomfort -Neckache
otcwarn: DO NOT USE -On damaged, irritated, or infected skin -With a bandage or heating pad -If you are allergic to any ingredients in this product -In the eyes, nose, or mouth -Otherwise as directed STOP USE AND ASK DOCTOR IF -Any of the warnings apply to you -Excessive skin irritation develops -Condition worsens -Symptoms persist for more than 7 days, or symptoms clear up and occur again within 3 days
